description: Systemd Unit Hardening Audit — Offline audit of a systemd .service unit (text= or url=), modeled on systemd-analyze security: runs as root, ProtectSystem/ProtectHome/PrivateTmp/NoNewPrivileges, kernel and device protections, SystemCallFilter, RestrictAddressFamilies, capability bounding set and dangerous capabilities, secrets in ExecStart or Environment, curl|sh, user-writable exec paths, UMask, + and ! exec prefixes. Returns exposure 0-10, label OK/MEDIUM/EXPOSED/UNSAFE, verdict, findings with line numbers and a suggested hardening drop-in. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_systemd_check
